meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: local or remote worker, local host-login observer or remote cmem.ai inference.

copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 在 Cursor 上安装 claude-mem：默认启动本地 worker，也可改用远程 worker，并选择观察者走远程推理（openrouter / cmem.ai）或本机登录。装好后提供 claude-mem-local、claude-mem-remote 两个 MCP 服务供连接。
howto.when: 当你要在 Cursor 上配置 claude-mem 时使用，包括选本地或远程 worker、以及观察者用本机登录还是远程 cmem.ai 推理。

say.text: 帮我在 Cursor 上装 claude-mem，用默认的本地 worker
观察者改成用本机登录，provider 设为 host
切换到远程 worker，服务器地址用我给你的域名

howto.what_en: Install claude-mem on Cursor: start a local worker by default, or use a remote worker, and pick the observer's inference (remote openrouter / cmem.ai or local host-login). It provides the MCP servers claude-mem-local and claude-mem-remote.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: choosing a local or remote worker, and a local host-login or remote cmem.ai observer.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on Cursor with the default local worker
Switch the observer to local host-login, provider host
say_en.note: Uses the loopback shim on port 37778

say_en.text: Switch to a remote worker using the host URL I give you
